result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. I only compiled it. No existing test calls this method, so I added no test and ran none, and I didn't check your Anna/Bob example.

The change is in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. I added `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery, the same filter the other per-rep counts use. I also added a note about it to the method's Javadoc.

The ordering and the listing of reps with 0 are unchanged, because the filter sits inside the per-rep subquery and the outer query is the same.
